info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to seek help, to beg, to irritate, to bless, to master

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: yAcanA karanA, rogI honA, SrImAn honA, ASIrvAda denA

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: upatApaH- jvaraprayuktA pIqA . ESvaryam - sampattiH . ASIH - ASAsanam . 'ASizi nATaH ' iti vArtikena ASIrarTe Atmanepadam . yAYcopatApESvaryArTezu parasmEpadam . dvikarmakoyaM yAYcArTe .

info.name: padam
info.note: kevalam 'ASIH' ityasmin arTe eva Atmanepadam . anyezu arTezu parasmEpadameva . aDikasandarBArTaM krIqo'nusampariByaSca 1.3.21 ityatra ASizi nATaH iti vArttikam drazwavyam .

examples: 'mARavakamupanATati, aNga putrakADIzva' (pA0 2.3.55 sUtravfttO pratyudAharaRam). upanATati yAcate upacCandayati. rAjAnamupanATati. yAcate prArTayate.
